items.exampleEn: The lady in the black coat is my aunt.
items.exampleZh: 穿黑色外套的那位女士是我阿姨。

items.exampleEn: My father is an engineer. He works in a factory.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸是工程師，他在工廠工作。

items.exampleEn: Hi, I am Tina. Nice to meet you.
items.exampleZh: 嗨，我是 Tina，很高興認識你。

items.exampleEn: Excuse me, sir, is this your bag?
items.exampleZh: 先生，不好意思，這是您的包包嗎？

items.exampleEn: She is not sick now. She is her old self again.
items.exampleZh: 她病好了，又回到原來的樣子了。

items.exampleEn: The cop helps the old man.
items.exampleZh: 那位警察幫助那位老先生。

items.audioEn: No, sir, I am not a cop. I am an engineer.
items.audioZh: 不是的，先生，我不是警察，我是工程師。

items.sentenceEn: The cop helps the lady find her bag.
items.sentenceZh: 警察幫那位女士找她的包包。

items.sentenceEn: My grandpa is his old self again.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺又回到原來的樣子了。

items.stemZh: 歡迎來參加我們的派對！

items.stemEn: Excuse me, ____. Is this your phone?
items.stemZh: 先生，不好意思，這是您的手機嗎？

items.passageEn: Hi, I am Helen. I am an engineer. Today is my first day at a new office. A lady at the door says, "Welcome!" She shows me my desk. Then a man gives me a cup of coffee. I say, "Thanks!" Everyone here is nice.
items.passageZh: 嗨，我是 Helen，我是工程師。今天是我在新辦公室的第一天。門口的一位女士說：「歡迎！」她帶我看我的辦公桌。接著一位男士給我一杯咖啡，我說：「謝謝！」這裡每個人都很好。

questions.questionZh: 誰給 Helen 一杯咖啡？

rubricZh: welcome 後面用 to 接地點（例如 Welcome to Taiwan!）
可以加上稱呼（例如 Welcome to Taiwan, my friend!），沒加也正確

referenceEn: Thanks, I feel much better now.
Thanks. I am much better now.
rubricZh: 道謝可寫，例如 Thanks、Thanks a lot 等
「好多了」可寫，例如 much better、a lot better 等；用 feel 或 be 動詞都正確
